summary: Willamette National Forest L-4 ground cabin on Bachelor Mountain, Linn County: built 1934, removed 1967; Forest Service trail 3420 reaches the former lookout site.

facts.status_note: Cab removed in 1967 per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed and the Oregon lookouts page says disposed of by burning. No source describes remains on the site.

access.note: Forest Service trail 3420 with directions from Detroit to the trailhead; the trail page describes the former lookout site as a viewpoint and does not describe any closure of the site itself

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1967, firelookout.com says destroyed in 1967, and the Oregon lookouts page says disposed of by burning that year. All three agree on the year; the story reports the method as the Oregon lookouts page describes it and notes the other two terms.

notes_for_editor: Built year, design and 1967 removal are agreed across the register, firelookout.com and the Oregon lookouts page. Brief record checked: kind 'ground' and design 'L-4' are supported by the 1934 'ground cabin' note; coordinates and elevation match the register; no corrections. Brief access 'unknown' is now 'public' on the strength of the Forest Service trail page, which lists a trail to the former site with directions and no closure for that trail (the page carries a general Willamette wildfire-closure alert, which is not specific to this trail). The Oregon lookouts page's remark about remains being thrown into a toilet pit was left out as not needed. No staffing record found in any source read, so staffing is omitted. Used one WebSearch and four distinct page reads.
